mapper.sql: warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name, address, manager, phone, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.insert: insert into wms_warehouse (warehouse_code, warehouse_name, address, manager, phone, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{address}, #{manager}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: select count(1) from wms_warehouse where warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode} and warehouse_id != #{warehouseId}

select (select count(1) from wms_area where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) + (select count(1) from wms_receipt where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) + (select count(1) from wms_shipment where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) + (select count(1) from wms_stock where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) + (select count(1) from wms_stock_movement where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId})
